text:
ria: Quick RFC follow-up: after yesterday's false-positive golden eval we should add a cheap deterministic intake fast-check to catch tokenizer and kv-cache layout mismatches before any heavy benches run. Noticed increased manual-review noise.

ash: +1. Sketch: two tiny checks run inline in intake (under 20ms): 1) tokenizer sample-map (hash of first N tokenized separators + top-k token ids for sample strings) vs catalog; 2) shape/kv-layout check (embedding dim, n_layers, kv_cache_format). If either diverges, mark intake as FAST_REJECT/DEFER_EVAL/SHADOW.

sam: love the triage modes. Example rule logic (pseudo):

```
if sample_map_hash != catalog.sample_hash:
  return FAST_REJECT
if embedding_dim != catalog.embedding_dim or kv_format != catalog.kv_format:
  return DEFER_EVAL
return ACCEPT_SHADOW
```

leo: tiny nit: make sample-map deterministic across SDK/runtime variants. Use canonical whitespace normalization + top-3 token ids for each sample sentence. Also include rare-token ratio delta metric so we can spot tokenizers that merge/split rare tokens.

ria: ops tradeoff: we must keep ~0 cost for free-tier/model labs. Proposal: intake descriptor gets flag: "fastcheck_mode": [off|shadow|enforce]. Default shadow for labs, enforce for hosted/dedicated.

ash: telemetry: emit event fastcheck.v1 with fields: product, model_ref, result, diffs:list, sample_hash, delta_rare_ratio, latency_ms. Keep diffs small (<=128 bytes).

sam: rollout: implement in shadow for 72h over 5% of intakes, collect FP/FN signals vs golden evals, then promote. Also create an automated replay job that replays failed-fast intakes through full bench to verify misses.

leo: ops on-call risk: if we FAST_REJECT a model that customers depend on, we need quick unblock path. Add UI action: "allowlist-once" that bypasses enforcement and logs reason. Also surface suggested fallback model variant from model catalog if available.

ria: good. Also want a small "diff artifact" attached to intake when DEFER_EVAL occurs: include the 8 sample token mappings and the first 4 input->token sequences. That should be enough for triage.

ash: I'll prototype the token-sampler and a compact binary sample-map serializer today. Will add unit tests for deterministic normalization.

sam: I'll wire telemetry and a replay job to compare fastcheck outputs vs golden evaluations.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-4837 and scheduled shadow window 4802300000-4802560000.

ria: action owners: ash proto sampler, sam telemetry+replay, leo unblock UI, ria owns rollout doc. Sync in 45.

leo: ack.

sam: ack.
